payload.name: CompleteAffectedGroupMemberSearches
payload.description: When a question asks who in a family or group was injured, hurt, sick, or otherwise affected, expand searches across member roles and condition synonyms before answering.
content: When a question asks which members of a family or group were affected (injured, hurt, sick, in an accident, etc.), treat it as a completeness query: after any hit, run additional searches pairing each known or role-based member (son, daughter, partner, spouse, child, friend) with condition synonyms (accident, injury, ankle, hospital, doctor, illness, therapy).

Before giving a final answer, verify that you have searched for all plausible group members and alternate phrasings; if the evidence covers only one member or one wording, continue searching rather than answering.

solves: When a question asks which members of a family or group were injured or otherwise affected, a single lexical search often misses a relevant memory because the event is phrased differently (e.g., 'soccer accident' vs. 'injured'). This rule requires member-aware query expansion and a completeness check before answering; it applies to any group-condition retrieval question and is not needed for single-subject queries.
